status: Locked after implementation and full-suite verification, before any SpatialTrackerV2 trajectory inference or trajectory scoring.
claim_boundary: One-case post-open observation-competence control on the previously examined single_lift_cloth source interaction. Frame-zero manual identity coordinates are supplied as an association oracle. The result may reject SpatialTrackerV2 as a PhysTwin sparse-identity feeder or authorize an automatic frame-zero graph-query source study. It cannot establish forecasting performance, transfer, calibration, state of the art, or permission to inspect any fresh or held-v8 target.
question: Does official SpatialTrackerV2 recover persistent metric material identities from a causal RGB-D prefix with materially broader and more accurate support than the frozen strict-three-view CoTracker3 comparator?
case_selection: The same already-open source case used by the frozen TAPIP3D competence control. It was selected before SpatialTrackerV2 inference because all nine released manual identities are visible in camera 0 at frame zero and agree with sensor depth to within 1 mm.

verification.repo_wide_ruff: not claimed; eight pre-existing findings remain in untouched files

spatialtrackerv2.license: CC BY-NC 4.0; external research dependency, not vendored

gauge.input_extrinsics: known camera-to-world transforms passed to the official RGB-D path
gauge.model_output: tracks transformed by the model-returned camera-to-initial-camera trajectory, matching official inference.py
gauge.approved_world_conversion: one fixed camera-0-to-PhysTwin-world SE(3) transform from the locked calibration
gauge.score_time_alignment: none; no fitted translation, SE(3), Sim(3), affine map, or scale

cotracker3_comparator.description: Frozen nearest-node frame-zero association followed by strict-three-view, gauge-anchored CoTracker3 displacement, re-anchored to the identical nine query coordinates.

metrics.support_denominator: finite released manual identity-frame pairs in frames [0, 121)
metrics.displacement_rmse: Euclidean RMSE of tracker displacement relative to each tracker's frame-zero coordinate against released manual displacement.
metrics.shared_support_comparison: SpatialTrackerV2 and CoTracker3 are compared only on identity-frame pairs valid for both, preventing different support from creating the relative accuracy result.
metrics.position_rmse: Euclidean world-position RMSE on each method's valid identity-frame pairs.
metrics.frame_zero_anchor_rmse: Euclidean RMSE between predicted and supplied frame-zero query coordinates.
metrics.late_third: Frames [80, 121), with start computed as floor(2 * 121 / 3).
metrics.common_translation_diagnostic: Per-frame mean displacement error and residual RMSE after removing that mean; diagnostic only and not a gate.

competence_gate.pass_action: Freeze this result and design an automatic frame-zero graph-query study on opened source data only. Do not open a fresh target.
competence_gate.fail_action: Stop SpatialTrackerV2 as the PhysTwin sparse-identity feeder without tuning on this opened source trajectory.

inference_inputs: nine frame-zero manual identity coordinates as query locations

technical_failure_policy.rule: Record an inference failure without scoring. Any lower-resolution, lower-track-count, camera, window, or memory-setting retry requires a separately committed amendment before another model run.

forbidden: changing SpatialTrackerV2 inference settings, visibility threshold, gauge conversion, comparator support, metric definitions, or competence thresholds after model inference
using manual identity coordinates after frame zero to generate, select, align, repair, or admit the prediction
fitting any score-time translation, rigid, similarity, affine, or scale alignment
calling this association-oracle source control deployable, predictive, transferable, calibrated, confirmatory, or state of the art
integrating SpatialTrackerV2 into Bayesian-PhysTwin before all competence gates pass
opening any fresh-object outcome on the authority of this one-case control
opening, inspecting, modifying, or rerunning any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
